findings.evidence: `grep -rn '^namespace TauCeti' TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialComplex/` matches only OrderComplex.lean:47 and Subdivision.lean:54; `grep -rl 'TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex' TauCeti/` matches only the two new files. Product.lean:105 puts `SimplicialMap.orderedProdFst` in the root `PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap`.
findings.fix: Drop `namespace TauCeti`/`end TauCeti` from both files and declare into the root `AbstractSimplicialComplex` and `PreAbstractSimplicialComplex` namespaces, removing the `_root_.` prefixes; update the docstring names accordingly.
findings.issue: All new declarations live in `TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex` / `TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex(.SimplicialMap)`, while every other file in this directory declares into the root `AbstractSimplicialComplex` / `PreAbstractSimplicialComplex` namespaces (Basic.lean:18, Maps.lean:24, Product.lean:45 and 105). Consequences: `_root_.` qualification is needed ~20 times in the diff, and `SimplicialMap.barycentricMap`/`faceOrderHom` are in a `SimplicialMap` namespace that is not the namespace of the `SimplicialMap` structure, so they do not join `SimplicialMap.comp`/`id`/`orderedProdFst` and `f.barycentricMap` does not resolve the way `f.comp` does.

findings.evidence: `grep -rn 'omparable' mathlib/Mathlib` yields only prose/tactic-internal hits, no theorem names; Mathlib uses `Nat.le_or_le`, `Fin.succ_le_or_le_castSucc`, `IsPreconnected.subset_or_subset` (Mathlib/Topology/Connected/Basic.lean:388), `Finset.exists_subset_or_subset_of_two_mul_lt_card`. The adjacent repo lemma extracting a face condition is `isChain_of_mem_orderedProd` (Product.lean:93).
findings.issue: `comparable_of_mem_orderComplex` uses terminology that appears in no Mathlib declaration name; the conclusion is `p ≤ q ∨ q ≤ p`, which the naming dictionary spells `le_or_le`. Same problem at Subdivision.lean:90, where `comparable_of_mem_barycentricSubdivision` concludes `σ ⊆ τ ∨ τ ⊆ σ` (Mathlib spelling `subset_or_subset`).

findings.evidence: TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialComplex/Basic.lean:21 `abbrev Face {ι : Type*} (K : AbstractSimplicialComplex ι) := {σ : Finset ι // σ ∈ K}`, used as `Face K` throughout Realization.lean:87-115.
findings.fix: Name it `PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.Face`, matching `AbstractSimplicialComplex.Face` in Basic.lean:21, and state `barycentricSubdivision K := orderComplex (Face K)`.
findings.issue: `BarycentricVertex K := {σ : Finset α // σ ∈ K}` is the same object as the existing `AbstractSimplicialComplex.Face K := {σ : Finset ι // σ ∈ K}` under a different name, and it names the type by one downstream use (vertices of the subdivision) rather than by what it is (a face of `K`). Downstream lemma statements then read `σ : BarycentricVertex K` where `σ` is just a face.

findings.evidence: OrderComplex.lean:116 `def orderComplexMap` for `orderComplex`; Subdivision.lean:66 `def barycentricSubdivision` but line 124 `def barycentricMap`. Mathlib uses `barycentric` for affine barycentric coordinates (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/AffineSpace/Basis.lean).
findings.issue: `barycentricMap` does not name the construction it is functorial for, unlike this PR's own `orderComplexMap` (named `orderComplex` + `Map`); the construction here is `barycentricSubdivision`. `barycentric` alone also collides with the standard meaning of barycentric coordinates/maps, which realization work in this directory will need.

summary: The new declarations are placed in `TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex` / `TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex`, breaking the root-namespace convention of every other file in this directory and detaching `barycentricMap`/`faceOrderHom` from the actual `SimplicialMap` namespace. Two lemmas use the non-Mathlib term `comparable` for `≤ ∨ ≤` / `⊆ ∨ ⊆`, and `BarycentricVertex` renames the existing `AbstractSimplicialComplex.Face` subtype.
